QuickCapture.Guide.Title: Start taking notes
QuickCapture.Guide.Body:
# Start with one note

This sample note is yours to edit or delete. Enter text, then switch between **Edit** and **Preview** to see your Markdown.

## What you can do

- Capture ideas, meeting notes, links, and temporary information; a title is optional
- Pin frequently used content to the Pinned tab and unpin it whenever you need to
- With clipboard history enabled, copied text, links, and images appear in the Clipboard tab
- Drag images or files into a note, or add and remove attachments in its details
- Search titles and note text to find an earlier record

## Markdown cheat sheet

| What to write | Example input |
| --- | --- |
| Bold text | `**Important**` |
| Task list | `- [ ] Follow up` |
| Link | `[DeskBox](https://deskbox.fun)` |

```md
## Meeting notes
- [ ] Confirm the next step
- [ ] Attach the reference material
```

> This sample is ordinary content. Once you rewrite it, it stays with your notes.

Check the three steps above one by one. When they are all complete, the task moves to Completed; you can uncheck it to keep working.

## Task details

| Feature | When it helps |
| --- | --- |
| Importance and color | Separate priorities, projects, or contexts |
| Date and reminder | Set a follow-up time for time-sensitive work |
| Recurrence | Handle daily, weekly, or regular tasks |
| Attachments | Keep reference files, images, or materials |

## Write the details in Notes

Put longer context, decisions, and progress here with Markdown. You can also add lists and code-style text:

```text
Meeting outcome
1. Confirm the owner
2. Follow up on Friday
```

- [ ] Add background information

Settings.Music.SmtcNotice.Title: Why do some players not show up?
Settings.Music.SmtcNotice.Description:
The Music widget reads playback and sends controls through the Windows system media session (SMTC), so DeskBox sees exactly what Windows sees. Some players do not join the system media session by default, and those cannot be read. To verify, press a volume key to open the Windows media flyout — if the track is missing there too, the player is not connected to the system media session. Look for a related switch in the player’s own settings (often named “system media controls”, “SMTC”, or “media key integration”; some player updates reset it) and turn it on.

Duration, the progress bar, and controls such as repeat and shuffle depend on the data and capabilities the player exposes to Windows; when a player does not provide them, those areas stay empty or unavailable.

Startup.FullyElevatedNotice.StepSecpol: Windows Pro and above: press Win+R, type secpol.msc, and open "Local Security Policy". Settings.Backup.StoreUninstallDataNotice: Uninstalling the Store version deletes local backup snapshots

When DeskBox is installed from the Microsoft Store, local backup and restore snapshots are kept in the system-managed app-data folder and are deleted when the app is uninstalled. A custom backup directory must live outside the AppData folders (for example, under Documents) — any folder inside AppData is managed by the Store sandbox the same way and is deleted with the app. WebDAV cloud backups are stored on the remote server and are not affected by uninstalling. To keep local snapshots, export them first or use cloud backup.

Settings.Dialog.SafeMigrationWarning:
Important files should have a separate backup before you begin.

All files will be copied and checked before the storage paths switch. Original files stay in their old locations and are never automatically deleted.

Large files or many small files can take a long time to copy and verify. The destination needs room for the entire collection plus working space; interrupted copies may occupy additional space.

Keep the computer powered on and both drives connected and unlocked. Do not edit the source or destination files during migration. A locked file, full disk, disconnected drive or failed check stops the whole task without switching paths.

Copying from a BitLocker drive to an unencrypted drive does not preserve BitLocker protection. Local NTFS volumes are supported; linked folders and EFS-encrypted files require manual handling.

CustomWidget.ApiDocs.Manual.generated-fr: > Generated from the DeskBox runtime capability registry. Reference `@module-id` or use **Capabilities** in Studio to attach exact contracts to the prompt context, or edit `manifest.json` directly for 200ms hot-reload.
CustomWidget.ApiDocs.Manual.no-duplicate: - **No Duplicate Inner Header**: The host window chrome already renders the widget icon, title, collapse toggle, and context menu. Do not place a duplicate static header bar at the top of `view`.
CustomWidget.ApiDocs.Manual.direct-live-: - **Direct Live Controls**: `Slider`, `Toggle`, and `Segmented` dispatch `onChange` immediately via `${$value}`; avoid redundant confirmation buttons next to live controls.
